keys.name: Causes of 1857

rows.v: Handicrafts ruined; British cloth free in, Indian cloth taxed 80%+ in Britain; heavy land tax; cash crops
Subsidiary Alliance, Doctrine of Lapse, Awadh annexed 1856 (Wajid Ali Shah); Nana Sahib's pension stopped 1851; Mughal heirs to leave the Red Fort
Corrupt police, courts; Indians kept out of high posts; Inam Commission 1852 (about 20,000 estates taken)
Religious Disabilities Act 1850 (converts inherit); sati ban, widow remarriage seen as meddling; fear of conversion
General Service Enlistment Act 1856 (overseas); low pay; lost bhatta and free post
Enfield P-53 cartridge greased with cow, pig fat; bitten open
Chapatis and lotus flowers passed round

traps: Cartridge = immediate cause, not deep cause
